english.title: Use / cause / permit use of vehicle likely to cause danger at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

on a part of Bristol Airport to which the Road Traffic Enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), at a time when

(D)_[the condition of the vehicle]_
(E)_[the number of passengers carried by it]_
(F)_[the manner in which passengers were carried in it]_
(G)_[the weight of the load of the vehicle]_
(H)_[the distribution of the load of the vehicle]_
(I)_[the packing of the load of the vehicle]_
(J)_[the adjustment of the load of the vehicle]_

was such that danger was caused or was likely to be caused to a person in or on the vehicle or on Bristol Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6.10.1 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw applies on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
